then.description: Add the verbs **corrupt** and **drain** to the Necromancy School's repertoire, and when you **Make Camp** you can always mark Necromancy in addition to your normal 3 Prepared Schools.

else.description:
Gain the **Weave the Arcane** Wizard Starting Move, though you only have access to Necromancy. You start with Necromancy Prepared; mark it now.

 You can **Cast a Spell**+int by combining a verb and a substance from Necromancy to create an effect, as long as you have your arcane focus, both hands otherwise free, and the ability to speak aloud.

outcomes.text: Your unique 7-9 option is: forget Necromancy until you next **Make Camp**

submoves.title: Rise and Serve
submoves.description: When you **kill a living creature with a spell**, you can create a ghoul, skeleton, or zombie from their body (2 HP, inflicts 1 dmg). Undead you create are loyal to you and follow your commands, though only #intelligent ones (which these are not) can understand complex tasks.

title: A Ghost at the Feast
description: When you **kill a living creature with a spell**, instead of creating something from their corpse, you can create a ghost, shade, or shadow from their soul (1 HP, inflicts 2 dmg #piercing | #invisible #immaterial). If you mark a Condition, you can create two undead—one from body and one from soul.

outcomes.text: You can instead choose this: it drains your lifeforce; take 1 dmg **piercing**

submoves.description: When you **attune yourself to the ethereal shackles that bind your undead to your will**, you may mark a Condition, then redistribute HP between yourself and any of your **near** undead as you see fit.

title: Sanctum to Unlife
description: When you **set your mind to imbue a location with unholy power**, treat it as **Perform a Ritual**, but you can sacrifice living people or your own powerful undead 1-for-1 to negate each requirement—except for the last one. After you succeed, for each requirement the GM originally gave you, choose one benefit below:

bullets: Any creature that dies here automatically rises as an #undead that serves you
**holy** power is weak here, dealing half dmg (rounded down) and lessening other effects
It acts as a source of power for even darker rituals
It will attract willing devotees and followers
The change will last indefinitely (unless actively cleansed at its heart)

title: Shed this Mortal Coil
description: You've learned the secrets of lichdom. Gain a **Phylactery** (see Magic Items).
